svg.text: Amplitude P1: score-component decomposition and complete lag curves
Primary paired unit: speaker · complete components n=20/20
A · Repeat-averaged FIXED − RAW component contrasts
Non-C bars are descriptive paired speaker-bootstrap 95% point intervals; C reuses the frozen primary CI.
Algebra: ΔC = ΔB − ΔDmin; Δanchor_C = ΔB − Δanchor_D; Δsearch_gain = ΔD0 − ΔDmin.
Max |residual|: C identity 8.881784197001252e-16; anchor identity 8.881784197001252e-16; search identity 1.7763568394002505e-15. Algebraic decomposition only, not mediator shares.
Mean curves and pointwise 95% ribbons are reused from distance_curve_summary.csv (speaker-level aggregation).
Do not derive C from the cohort-mean curve: the component table uses each speaker’s saved condition metrics and repeat averages.
Curve ribbons and non-C component intervals are descriptive pointwise 95% intervals, not simultaneous tests. A rise in B alone is not evidence of gaming or lower audio quality.
